agent: the value-network agent (native, from step 3); round 0 data from 015's agent

round0.agent: 015's agent (fast_deep: reach_plan_014 with 015's numbers and commit ply)
round0.explore_note: 1%, not the plan's 5%: on 60 scratch seeds (no dev or held-out seed) 5% left 1 game of 60 reaching level 39 (015's agent alone: 48; 1%: 37), so the data would have had almost no 39+ boards

dev_seeds: seeds.json dev_seeds: compare on the first 100, confirm a keeper on the next 100

fit.lr_note: Adam, one-cycle schedule peaking at lr

probe.note: Tetris-ready stacks (column 9 empty; with even lines only multiples of 4 can occur); V must fall at each step in both, and lose a larger share of V(8) at 39+; last 5 is T

seeds_note: Training seeds are labelled fallgorithm020/train/v<round> (round 0: v0). The 16-bit seeds hold only 30,720 distinct start states, so later rounds draw fresh labels but may reuse earlier rounds' training start states (never a dev, held-out or excluded one); their games differ because the agent does.
